title: George Pratt
description: "STAR WARS was exactly what a kid would think of as the movie he would make if he could," observes George Pratt. "You'd look at all your favorite comic books, all your favorite science-fiction books, World War II war movies, and you'd say this is what I would do if I was in charge." Pratt's comic--style work has appeared in Marvel's EPIC ILLUSTRATED, HEAVY METAL and EAGLE magazine. A successful painter, his creations have been showcased in a number of prestigious museums.
